text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер and I are returning from a
photo
shoot she had in her signature
racewear. We're
walking down the
hallway when I realize
something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Тренер? Is something the matter?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking, the crest on your top
matches the badge you wear on your ear.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you have a good eye for details.
Yes, it's
the same symbol.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Did you know? It looks like a "G" if you
look at it
from the side.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Sei? How long have you been
listening?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, does that mean I got it right? Been
curious
for a while, actually.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Is the G supposed to be your initial? Or
does it
stand for something else, like
"Grace"?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Now, isn't that a good question.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Seiun keeps pressing for an answer, but
Grass
Wonder evades the question every
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wake up the next morning still curious
about the
design. Later, as I wait for
Grass Wonder for
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Hehe, why do
you look so
perplexed?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list:
I'm still trying to work out what the "G" stands
for...

text_block_list.text: Oh, I see...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I should've told you yesterday,
but I was
a bit too embarrassed to
answer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's just what Sei said—the "G" stands for
both my
name and "Grace."
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
There's a lot more to Грасс Вандер than
just
being graceful and polite. Perhaps
that's why her
explanation doesn't sit
quite right with me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: There has to be more to it than that.
It could mean "Green Tea" too, couldn't it?

text_block_list.text: But?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: There has to be more to it than that.
It could mean "Green Tea" too, couldn't it?

text_block_list.text: Well... Um.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As a matter of fact, there is.
You're quite
astute.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I'm a little flattered that
you
noticed. Not many people do, you
know.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but that's all I'll say for now. It's
about time
we started training.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She gracefully steps out onto the track,
but then
suddenly turns to face me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can tell you one last thing. I
like to
always carry a reminder of what's
important to
me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And as you know, my ambitions are not
easily
satisfied. So I hope you will aid me
in achieving...
the goals I seek.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Well... It definitely does now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The symbol represents what's important
to me,
and green tea certainly fits the
bill.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Still... it makes me happy that you've put
so much
thought into such a tiny aspect
of my racewear.
Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So I suppose... I'll let you in on my
secret. This
stays between us,
understood?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She smiles, leans in close, and whispers a
single
word.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The following week, Грасс Вандер
claims an
impressive victory during a
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The following week, she claims an
impressive
victory in a race. Seeing the
strength of her desire
to win, I'm filled
with a renewed determination to
support
her no matter what.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Struck by her determination to succeed,
I quietly
renew my own resolve to
support her until the day
she achieves...
the glory she deserves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
